description.zh-CN: 集群网络拓扑工作页：只读资源关系、自由布局、本地关联草稿与差异审查。不执行真实网络应用或回滚；真实集成待验。
description.en-US: Cluster topology work page: read-only resource relationships, layout editing, local relationship drafts and diff review. No live network apply or rollback; live integration pending.

compatibility.tower: CloudTower 4.9.0 target; topology work-page integration pending validation.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 通用 UI contributions 候选：插件声明网络拓扑工具栏入口与独立页面，要求框架 0.2.6；保留切语时的关联草稿、布局与读取。真实集成待验，真实事务与独立回滚为本轮接续目标，当前不可用。
releaseNotes.en-US: Generic UI contributions candidate: declares its own topology toolbar entry and page, requiring framework 0.2.6; preserves drafts, layout and reads on locale changes. Live integration pending. Live transactions and independent rollback remain ongoing work and are currently unavailable.
